errors.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to this page
errors.forbiddenBody: Your role doesn't include the permission this page needs. Ask an administrator if you think this is wrong.
errors.notFoundBody: The link may be old or mistyped.
errors.crashTitle: Something went wrong on our side
errors.crashBody: The problem has been logged. Try again; if it keeps happening, give IT Support the reference below.

codes.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong on our side. The problem has been logged — please try again or give IT Support the reference.
codes.VALIDATION: Some fields need attention. Check the highlighted fields.
codes.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
codes.PERMISSION_DENIED: You don't have permission to do this.
codes.MFA_REQUIRED: Confirm your two-factor code first, then try again.
codes.REAUTH_REQUIRED: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
codes.REAUTH_FAILED: The password you entered is not correct.
codes.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find that record. It may have been removed.
codes.CONFLICT: This conflicts with an existing record (for example a name that is already used).
codes.DUPLICATE_SUBMISSION: This form is already being saved. Please wait a moment.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
codes.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed sign-ins. This account is locked for {minutes} minutes.
codes.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account is suspended. Contact your administrator.
codes.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Email or password is not correct. {remaining, plural, =0 {The account is now locked for 15 minutes.} one {# attempt left before a 15-minute lock.} other {# attempts left before a 15-minute lock.}}
codes.PASSWORD_WEAK: That password is too weak. Use at least 10 characters with a mix of letters, numbers or symbols.
codes.PASSWORD_BREACHED: That password has appeared in a data breach. Choose a different one.
codes.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists.
codes.PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION: You can't grant access you don't have yourself.
codes.LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: There must always be at least one active Super Admin.
codes.SELF_ACTION_FORBIDDEN: You can't do this to your own account. Ask another administrator.
codes.PROTECTED_ROLE: The Super Admin role is protected and can't be changed or deleted.
codes.ROLE_IN_USE: This role still has {detail} user(s). Move them to another role first.
codes.SYSTEM_ROLE: System roles can be edited but not deleted. Use "Reset to default" instead.
codes.HAS_RECORDS: This user has legal or financial records, so they can only be suspended or soft-deleted.
codes.DISTRICT_OUT_OF_SCOPE: You can only assign districts you manage yourself.
codes.SETUP_ALREADY_DONE: Setup is already complete. Sign in instead.
codes.GOOGLE_NO_STAFF_ACCOUNT: There's no staff account for this Google email. Ask an administrator to create one.
codes.MAKER_CHECKER: You created this record, so someone else must approve it.
codes.SESSION_EXPIRED: You were signed out after a period of inactivity. Please sign in again.

validation.name: Enter at least 2 characters.
validation.otp_wrong: That code is not correct or has expired.

validation.setup_token: The setup token is not correct.

validation.code_taken: This code is already used here.

auth.staffLoginBody: Sign in with the email and password your administrator gave you.
auth.googleStaffOnly: Google sign-in works only for existing staff accounts.
auth.citizenLoginBody: We'll send a 6-digit code by SMS. No password needed.
auth.forgotBody: Enter your staff email and we'll send you a reset link.
auth.resetSentBody: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. The link works once.
auth.passwordRules: At least {min} characters. Mix letters with numbers or symbols. Breached passwords are rejected.
auth.mustChangeBody: Your account was created with a temporary password. Set a new one to continue.
auth.changePasswordBody: Enter your current password and choose a new one.
auth.resetBody: Choose a new password for your account.
auth.inviteBody: Choose a password to activate your staff account.
auth.mfaBody: Staff accounts are protected with a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy…).
auth.mfaStep1: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
auth.mfaQrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
auth.mfaStep2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
auth.panelTitle: Every plot in Banadir, on one register.
auth.panelBody: Registration, property tax and maps for the people of Mogadishu.

setup.title: First-time setup
setup.body: Create the first Super Admin. This page locks itself once it's done.
setup.tokenHint: The SETUP_TOKEN value from the server environment.
setup.doneBody: Sign in now. You'll be asked to turn on two-factor authentication.
setup.lockedBody: A Super Admin already exists, so this page is locked.

landing.headline: Land registration, property tax and maps — in one place.
landing.lead: Apply for registration, follow your request, pay your property tax by mobile money and download your certificate.
landing.citizenBody: Sign in with your phone number to see your properties, bills and requests.
landing.staffBody: Registry, revenue, GIS and administration for Banadir staff.
landing.verifyBody: Scan the QR code on a title certificate or ID card to check it is valid.
landing.entriesTitle: Where do you want to go?

apply.title: Apply
apply.body: Online, at the office or with a field officer.

survey.title: Survey
survey.body: Your plot is measured and drawn on the map.

register.title: Register
register.body: Verified and given a unique PUN.

pay.title: Pay
pay.body: EVC Plus, Zaad, Sahal, eDahab, bank or cash.

certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.body: Title and ID card with a QR check.

portal.title: My Dhulka
portal.myPropertiesBody: Your registered parcels, bills and requests.
portal.emptyBody: Apply online: tell us where the property is, add your documents and submit.
portal.myApplicationsBody: Your requests and where they are.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Phase 1 foundation is live: accounts, roles, security and audit.
dashboard.roadmapBody: Each phase adds working modules end to end.
dashboard.mfaOn: Two-factor authentication is on for this session.
dashboard.mfaOff: Two-factor authentication is not verified for this session.
dashboard.securityBody: Never share your password or codes. IT Support will never ask for them.
dashboard.invitedAlertTitle: {count, plural, one {# invited user hasn't} other {# invited users haven't}} activated their account yet

p1.title: Foundation
p1.body: Auth, 2FA, users, roles, RLS, audit, i18n

p12.title: Migration & go-live
p12.body: Legacy import, load and security tests

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Staff accounts, roles and district access.
users.newSubtitle: Create a staff account. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
users.emptyBody: Change the filters or create a new user.
users.rolesHelp: A user can have several roles. Roles needing access you don't have are disabled.
users.selfRolesLocked: You can't change your own roles or districts. Ask another administrator.
users.districtsHelp: District staff only see records in these districts.
users.tempPasswordHint: Shown once after saving. The user must change it at first sign-in.
users.inviteHelp: The user receives an email link to choose their own password.
users.passwordOnceBody: This is the only time it is shown. Give it to the user in person or by phone — never by email.
users.readOnly: You can view this user but not edit them.

security.title: Security & status
security.subtitle: Actions here take effect immediately and are recorded in the audit log.
security.selfNote: Some actions are not available on your own account.
security.passwordBody: Set a new temporary password, or email a reset link.
security.setPasswordBody: The user is signed out everywhere and must change this password at next sign-in. It's copied to your clipboard.
security.mfaOn: 2FA is on. Reset it if the user lost their phone.
security.signoutBody: Sign the user out of every device now.
security.suspendBody: Blocks sign-in immediately. History is kept and the account can be reactivated.
security.reactivateBody: Allow this user to sign in again.
security.deleteBody: Soft delete keeps history. Hard delete is only possible without legal or financial records.
security.deleteConfirmBody: Choose how to delete this account, then confirm with your own password.
security.softDeleteBody: The account is marked deleted and blocked. Records and history stay.
security.hardDeleteBody: Permanently removes the account and frees the email. Super Admin only.
security.hardDeleteBlocked: Not available: only a Super Admin can hard delete, and only users without legal or financial records.
security.yourPasswordHint: Sensitive actions need your password again.
security.deletedBody: It can't sign in. History is kept in the audit log.

done.reset_2fa: 2FA reset. The user will set it up again at next sign-in.
done.set_password: Password set and copied to your clipboard

suspend.title: Suspend this user?
suspend.body: {email} will be signed out and blocked from signing in.

reactivate.title: Reactivate this user?
reactivate.body: {email} will be able to sign in again.

force_signout.title: Sign out everywhere?
force_signout.body: {email} will need to sign in again on every device.

reset_2fa.title: Reset two-factor authentication?
reset_2fa.body: {email}'s authenticator will stop working and they'll set up a new one.

send_reset_link.title: Email a reset link?
send_reset_link.body: A one-time reset link will be sent to {email}.

resend_invite.title: Resend the invitation?
resend_invite.body: A new invitation will be sent to {email}.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.subtitle: Roles are data: create, copy and edit them any time. Users get the union of their roles.
roles.newSubtitle: Pick exactly what this role can do and how much data it sees.
roles.deleteBody: This can't be undone. The deletion is recorded in the audit log.
roles.deleteInUse: {count, plural, one {# user still has} other {# users still have}} this role.
roles.moveHelp: Choose a role to move them to. They'll be moved and the role deleted in one step.
roles.systemRoleNote: System role — it can be edited or reset, but not deleted.
roles.protectedBody: The Super Admin role always has every permission and can't be edited or deleted.
roles.scopeHelp: Which records holders of this role can see. With several roles the widest scope applies.
roles.scopeHelp_own: Only records they created or own.
roles.scopeHelp_district: Records in the user's assigned district.
roles.scopeHelp_districts: Records in all the user's assigned districts.
roles.permissionsHelp: {count, plural, one {# permission selected} other {# permissions selected}}. Permissions you don't have yourself are disabled.
roles.resetBody: Restore the permissions this system role shipped with. Users with this role are notified.

permissionsPage.title: Permission catalog
permissionsPage.subtitle: Every permission key in the system. Roles combine these.

loginHistory.title: Login history
loginHistory.subtitle: Every sign-in attempt, successful or not. Five failures lock an email for 15 minutes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: System settings (secrets are never shown).
settings.readOnlyNote: Settings are read-only in phase 1. Editing with approval arrives with the modules that use them.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who changed what, when, from where — with before and after values. Entries can't be edited or deleted.

design.title: Design system
design.subtitle: Tokens and components used across Dhulka. Switch theme and language to check both.
design.bodyText: calm, readable body text for long forms.
design.mutedText: Secondary text for hints and metadata.
design.formsBody: Labels, hints and inline errors wired for screen readers.
design.fieldError: Enter the number in international format.
design.confirmBody: A credit note will be issued. This can't be undone.
design.alertBody: Alerts explain what happened and what to do next.
design.emptyBody: Empty states always offer the next action.

map.title: Map
map.noBoundaries: No boundaries are mapped yet. Import them under Locations → Boundary.

locations.title: Locations
locations.subtitle: The location hierarchy used everywhere: districts, sections, sectors, neighbourhoods, streets and facilities, with their boundaries.
locations.emptyBody: Add the first one, or change the filters.
locations.name: Name
locations.archiveBody: It disappears from pickers and the map. Nothing is deleted and it can be restored.
locations.restoreBody: It becomes available again in pickers and on the map.
locations.noSections: No sections in this district yet
locations.noSectors: No sectors in this section yet
locations.codeHint: Capital letters or digits, unique within the parent.
locations.codeHintNeighbourhood: Unique within the district — it becomes part of every PUN here.
locations.boundaryHelp: Upload a GeoJSON file (WGS84 longitude/latitude) or paste GeoJSON. Invalid shapes are repaired automatically.
locations.geomError_outside_Somalia: The shape isn't in Somalia. Coordinates must be longitude, latitude (WGS84).
locations.geomError_wrong_geometry_type: Wrong kind of shape for this level (areas need polygons, streets need lines, facilities need points).
locations.help_districts: Districts of Banadir. The code is used in every PUN.
locations.help_sections: A section belongs to one district.
locations.help_sectors: A sector belongs to one section.
locations.help_neighbourhoods: A neighbourhood belongs to one sector. Its code is part of the PUN.
locations.help_facilities: Schools, mosques, hospitals and other public places.

applications.title: Applications
applications.subtitle: Registration, transfer and other requests from the portal, the office and the field.
applications.newSubtitle: Start with what and where. The draft is saved, so you can continue later.
applications.citizenNewSubtitle: Tell us where the property is. Your application is saved as a draft until you submit it.
applications.emptyBody: Change the filters or start a new application.
applications.neighbourhoodHint: Search by name or code. Dropping a pin fills this in.
applications.pinHint: Click the map at the property, or use GPS when you are on site.
applications.pinNoNeighbourhood: The pin is not inside any mapped neighbourhood.
applications.addressNoteHint: Landmarks that help the surveyor find the plot.
applications.awaitingPaymentBody: The application is complete. The fee invoice and mobile-money payment arrive with the payments module (phase 7); after payment it moves to survey.
applications.ownersHelp: Everyone with a right to the property. Owner and co-owner shares must add up to 100%.
applications.citizenOwnersNote: You are listed as the owner. If there are co-owners, the office will add them during verification.
applications.documentsHelp: PDF or photo, up to 10 MB each. Required documents are marked.
applications.reviewHelp: Fix anything listed below, then submit. You can't edit after submitting unless the office returns it.
applications.afterSubmitNote: You'll receive an SMS with the number. Track it any time on the tracking page.
applications.nearbyTitle: {count, plural, one {Another application is} other {# other applications are}} within 10 m of this pin

check.shares_not_100: Owner shares add up to {value}% — they must total 100%.
check.no_neighbourhood: Choose the neighbourhood (or drop a pin inside one).
check.no_pin: Put a pin on the map at the property.

actions.returnBody: The applicant can fix it and submit again.
actions.rejectBody: This ends the application. It stays in the records.
actions.cancelBody: It will be closed. Nothing is deleted.

pin.hint: Click the map to drop a pin at the property.

owners.title: Owners
owners.subtitle: People and organisations that own, co-own or act for a property.
owners.newSubtitle: Check for duplicates as you type — one person, one record.
owners.addedSaveHint: Owner created — press “Save owners” to add them to this application.
owners.motherNameHint: Used to tell apart people with the same name.
owners.districtHint: District staff see owners registered in their district.
owners.emptyBody: Change the search or register a new owner.
owners.dupesTitle: {count, plural, one {Possible duplicate found} other {# possible duplicates found}}
owners.dupesCitizen: Someone with matching details is already registered. The office will check this.

track.title: Track an application
track.body: Enter the application number from your SMS and the last 4 digits of the applicant's phone.
track.notFoundBody: Check the number and the last 4 digits. Drafts are not shown until submitted.
